entries.back_en:
Report 1

We find ourselves quite far from home, but it seems we have reached a habitable planet full of interesting life to be discovered. I really hope we haven't been hasty in our decision. I believe we have found the perfect creature. We call it "Blink". Blinks are elusive and managing to capture several of them was a true feat. Fortunately, all their cognitive ability is reduced to zero when they sleep in groups. The main reason for my choice is their ability to move from one place to another in the blink of an eye. I have never seen anything so fast in the history of Kortia's games. We have enough specimens. Tomorrow we will embark on our return trip. I'm simply eager to present our candidates to the committee. It's a shame we cannot take part this year, but it will be most interesting to see what strategies the other modules employ in an attempt to capture them.
entries.note: Accurate translation; meaning and tone preserved.
